title: Towards Resource Efficient and Interpretable Bias Mitigation in Large Language Models
findings: The proposed framework effectively reduced religious bias, performing similarly well for religion as it did for gender and race. The method's performance was consistent despite differences in the amount of fine-tuning data available for each bias type. Furthermore, the experiments indicated that mitigating bias in one dimension (e.g., race) often led to a reduction in religious bias as well, suggesting a correlation between different bias directions.
